title: Trigger
desc: Choose what happens when your OnlyKey is removed while armed
options_long: openCIK will immediately initiate a soft shutdown sequence. May cause data loss!
confirmation:
This selection may cause data loss! Are you sure you want to continue?

The 'soft-shutdown' trigger will immediately cause your computer to shutdown. This could cause you to lose work if, for example, you're writing an email or typing a text document.

Are you sure you want to select the 'soft-shutdown' trigger, despite the risk of data loss?

title: Trigger countdown
desc: How many seconds to wait after openCIK detects the OnlyKey was unplugged, before firing the trigger. Re-plug within this window aborts. Audio beep on each second.
